informal_statement: The Hilbert-style logical system K4 is weaker than KD4. That is, every theorem provable in K4 is also provable in KD4, making K4 a subset of KD4 in terms of its provable statements.
informal_proof: To show that K4 is weaker than KD4, we need to demonstrate that every theorem derivable in K4 is also derivable in KD4. This can be done by establishing that the set of theorems of K4 is a subset of the theorems of KD4. Using automated proof techniques, we introduce the necessary hypotheses and apply the `aesop` tactic to automatically verify the inclusion of K4’s theorems within KD4. Thus, we confirm that K4 indeed has fewer or the same set of theorems as KD4, establishing K4 as weaker than KD4.
